patents.title: Modified Watt II Six-Bar Linkage for Wheel-Track Transformable Manpackable Robot
patents.short_title: Modified Watt II Six-Bar Linkage Mechanism
patents.abstract: A compact, man-packable surveillance robot that transforms between wheel mode and track-belt mode using a single-actuator Modified Watt II six-bar linkage mechanism — enabling reliable traversal across diverse terrains for search-and-rescue, reconnaissance, and disaster-response applications.
